R48|base|6.26.1.heading: Individual specifications > Manoeuvring lamps
R48|base|6.26.1.text: Presence Optional on motor vehicles and trailers.

R48|base|6.26.2.heading: Individual specifications > Manoeuvring lamps
R48|base|6.26.2.text: Number Side mounted: One or two (one per side) on vehicles not exceeding 6m in length. A maximum of four (up to two per side) on vehicles above 6m and up to and including 9m in length. A maximum of six (up to three per side) on vehicles exceeding 9m in length. Rear mounted: One. However, installed lamps (mounted to the side or rear) shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.

R48|base|6.26.4.2.heading: Individual specifications > Manoeuvring lamps > Position
R48|base|6.26.4.2.text: In height: Side mounted: above the ground, not more than 1,500mm. Rear mounted: no higher than the vehicle.

R48|base|6.26.4.3.heading: Individual specifications > Manoeuvring lamps > Position
R48|base|6.26.4.3.text: In length: Side mounted: in the case of the installation of more than one manoeuvring lamp, lamps shall be mounted as symmetrically as practicable along each side of the vehicle. The distance between two adjacent manoeuvring lamps on the same side shall not be less than 0.5 m. Rear mounted: at the rear of the vehicle.

R48|base|6.26.6.heading: Individual specifications > Manoeuvring lamps
R48|base|6.26.6.text: Orientation Downwards, however the requirements of paragraph 6.26.9. apply.

R48|base|6.26.9.1.heading: Individual specifications > Manoeuvring lamps > Other requirements
R48|base|6.26.9.1.text: The Technical Service shall, to the satisfaction of the Type Approval Authority, perform a visual test to verify that there is no direct visibility of the apparent surface of these lamps, if viewed by an observer moving on the boundary of a zone on a transverse plane 10 m from the front of the vehicle, a transverse plane 10 m from the rear of the vehicle , and two longitudinal planes 10 m from each side of the vehicle; these four planes to extend from 1 m to 3 m above and parallel to the ground as shown in Annex 14.

R48|base|6.26.9.2.heading: Individual specifications > Manoeuvring lamps > Other requirements
R48|base|6.26.9.2.text: At the request of the applicant and with the consent of the Technical Service the requirement of 6.26.9.1 may be verified by a drawing or simulation or deemed be satisfied if the installation conditions comply with paragraph 6.2.2. of UN Regulation No. 23 or paragraph 5.10.2. of the 00 series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148 or paragraph 5.10.1.2. of the 01 and subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148, as noted in the communication document in Annex 1, paragraph 9.

R23|base|6.2.2.heading: INTENSITY OF LIGHT EMITTED > Intensity of the light specifications for manoeuvring lamps
R23|base|6.2.2.text: The device must be so designed that the light emitted directly towards the side, the front or the rear of the vehicle does not exceed 0.5 cd within the angular field as defined below. (a) The vertical minimum angle **φmin** (in degree) is: φmin = arctan ((1-mounting height)/10; where h is mounting height in m (b) The vertical maximum angle **φ** max (in degree) is: φ max **= φmin** = + 11,3. The measurement shall be limited to a horizontal angle ranging from +90° to -90° with respect to the line which cuts the reference axis and which is perpendicular to the vertical longitudinal plane of the vehicle. The measurement distance shall be in minimum 3 m.

R148|base|5.10.2.heading: Specific technical requirements > Manoeuvring lamps (ML)
R148|base|5.10.2.text: Minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility No requirements.

R148|base|5.10.1.2.heading: Specific technical requirements > Manoeuvring lamps (ML)
R148|base|5.10.1.2.text: The lamp must be so designed that the light emitted directly towards the side, the front or the rear of the vehicle does not exceed 5∙10-1 cd within the angular field as defined below. (a) The vertical minimum angle φmin (in degrees) is: φmin = arctan ((1-h)/10); where h is mounting height in m (b) The vertical maximum angle φmax (in degrees) is: φmax = φmin + 11.3 The measurement shall be limited to a horizontal angle ranging from +90° to -90° with respect to the line which cuts the reference axis and which is perpendicular to the vertical longitudinal plane of the vehicle.

R48|base|9.1.heading: Penalties for non-conformity of production
R48|base|9.1.text: The approval granted in respect of a type of vehicle pursuant to this Regulation may be withdrawn if the requirements are not complied with or if a vehicle bearing the approval mark does not conform to the type approved.

R48|base|9.2.heading: Penalties for non-conformity of production
R48|base|9.2.text: If a Party to the Agreement applying this Regulation withdraws an approval it has previously granted, it shall forthwith so notify the other Contracting Parties applying this Regulation by means of a communication form conforming to the model in Annex 1 to this Regulation.

R48|base|6.26.7.heading: Individual specifications > Manoeuvring lamps
R48|base|6.26.7.text: Electrical Connections Motor vehicles: Manoeuvring lamps shall be so connected that they cannot be switched ON unless the-main-beam headlamps or the dipped-beam headlamps of the motor vehicle are switched ON at the same time. The manoeuvring lamp(s) shall be switched ON automatically for slow manoeuvres up to 15 km/h provided that one of the following conditions is fulfilled: (a) Prior to the vehicle being set in motion for the first time after each manual activation of the propulsion system; or (b) Reverse gear is engaged; or (c) A camera-based system which assists parking manoeuvres is operating. The manoeuvring lamps shall be automatically switched OFF if the forward speed of the vehicle exceeds 15 km/h and they shall remain switched OFF until the switch ON conditions are met again. Trailers: Manoeuvring lamps shall be so connected that they cannot be activated unless the position lamps of the trailer are switched ON at the same time and shall take their input speed directly from the trailer. The manoeuvring lamp(s) shall be switched ON automatically for slow manoeuvres up to 15 km/h provided that one of the following conditions is fulfilled: (a) Prior to the trailer being set in motion for the first time after each manual activation of the vehicle propulsion system; or (b) The reverse lamp is switched ON; or (c) A camera-based system which assists parking manoeuvres is operating. The manoeuvring lamps shall be automatically switched OFF if the forward speed of the trailer exceeds 15 km/h and they shall remain switched OFF until the switch ON conditions are met again.

R48|base|6.26.3.heading: Individual specifications > Manoeuvring lamps
R48|base|6.26.3.text: Arrangement No special requirement, however the requirements of paragraph 6.26.9. apply.

R48|base|6.28.2.heading: Individual specifications > Reversing projection
R48|base|6.28.2.text: Number One or two reversing projection(s). The reversing projector(s) shall be type approved according to the 01 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.

R48|base|6.28.3.heading: Individual specifications > Reversing projection
R48|base|6.28.3.text: Arrangement Such that the provisions of paragraphs 6.28.5., 6.28.6. and 6.28.9. are fulfilled.

R148|base|5.12.1.2.heading: Specific technical requirements > Reversing projector (RP)
R148|base|5.12.1.2.text: In addition, outside of the projection area as defined by the individual specifications of UN Regulation No. 48, one of the following conditions shall be fulfilled: (a) The light emitted directly towards the rear of the vehicle shall not exceed 5∙10-1 cd within the angular field as defined below. (i) The vertical minimum angle φmin (in degrees) is: φmin = arctan ((1-h)/10); where h is mounting height in m (ii) The vertical maximum angle φmax (in degrees) is: φmax = φmin + 11.3 The measurement shall be limited to a horizontal angle ranging from +90° to -90° with respect to the line which cuts the reference axis and which is perpendicular to the vertical transversal plane of the vehicle. (b) When the apparent surfaces of the reversing projector and the apparent surface of the reversing lamp are arranged in such a way that: (i) Either the projection of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis of them occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projections of the said apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis; or (ii) The minimum distance between the facing edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis of them does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis, the reversing projector shall be tested together with the reversing lamp and the integrated luminous intensity shall not exceed the maximum luminous intensity required in the Table 10.

R48|base|6.28.4.heading: Individual specifications > Reversing projection
R48|base|6.28.4.text: Position Such that the provisions of paragraphs 6.28.5., 6.28.6. and 6.28.9. are fulfilled.

R48|base|6.28.7.1.heading: Individual specifications > Reversing projection > Electrical connections
R48|base|6.28.7.1.text: If provided, the reversing projections shall be switched ON only when the reversing lamp(s) is/are switched ON.

R48|base|6.28.7.2.heading: Individual specifications > Reversing projection > Electrical connections
R48|base|6.28.7.2.text: The system which operates the reversing projections may be automatically and/or manually deactivated and/or reactivated.

R48|base|8.1.heading: Individual specifications
R48|base|8.1.text: Any vehicle approved pursuant to this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set out in paragraphs 5. and 6. above.

R48|base|8.text: Conformity of production The conformity of production procedures shall comply with those set out in the Agreement, Appendix 2 (E/ECE/324-E/ECE/TRANS/505/Rev.2), with the following requirements:

R48|base|5.28.2.heading: General specifications > General provisions relating to geometric visibility
R48|base|5.28.2.text: If measurements are taken closer to the lamp, the direction of observation shall be shifted parallel to achieve the same accuracy.

R48|base|5.36.3.heading: General specifications > General provisions relating to geometric visibility
R48|base|5.36.3.text: The light transmitted downwards by light-signalling devices is not considered a reversing projection.

R48|base|Annex 9 1.1.heading: Annex 9 Control of conformity of production > Tests
R48|base|Annex 9 1.1.text: Position of lamps The position of lamps, as defined in paragraph 2.1.6. of this Regulation, in width, in height and in length shall be checked in accordance with the general requirements set out in paragraphs 2.10.2., 2.10.3., 2.10.4., 2.3.3. and 5.4. of this Regulation. The values measured for the distances shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.

R48|base|Annex 9 1.title: Tests
R48|base|Annex 9 1.heading: Annex 9 Control of conformity of production

R48|base|Annex 9 1.2.1.heading: Annex 9 Control of conformity of production > Tests > Visibility of lamps
R48|base|Annex 9 1.2.1.text: The angles of geometric visibility shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 2.10.7. of this Regulation. The values measured for the angles shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled except that the limits of the angles may have an allowance corresponding to the ±3º variation permitted in paragraph 5.3. for the mounting of the light-signalling devices.

R48|base|Annex 9 1.2.title: Visibility of lamps
R48|base|Annex 9 1.2.heading: Annex 9 Control of conformity of production > Tests

R48|base|Annex 9 1.2.2.heading: Annex 9 Control of conformity of production > Tests > Visibility of lamps
R48|base|Annex 9 1.2.2.text: The visibility of red light towards the front and of white light towards the rear shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 5.10. of this Regulation.

R48|base|Annex 9 1.3.1.heading: Annex 9 Control of conformity of production > Tests > Alignment of dipped-beam headlamps and front fog lamps towards the front
R48|base|Annex 9 1.3.1.text: Initial downward inclination The initial downward inclination of the cut-off of the dipped beam and the front fog lamps shall be set to the plated figure as required and shown in Annex 7. Alternatively, the manufacturer shall set the initial aim to a figure that is different from the plated figure where it can be shown to be representative of the type approved when tested in accordance with the procedures contained in Annex 6 and in particular paragraph 4.1.

R48|base|Annex 9 1.3.title: Alignment of dipped-beam headlamps and front fog lamps towards the front
R48|base|Annex 9 1.3.heading: Annex 9 Control of conformity of production > Tests
R48|base|Annex 9 1.3.text: Alignment of dipped-beam headlamps and front fog lamps towards the front

R48|base|4.1.heading: Approval
R48|base|4.1.text: If the vehicle type submitted for approval pursuant to this Regulation meets the requirements of the Regulation in respect of all the devices specified in the list, approval of that vehicle type shall be granted.

R48|base|Annex 9 1.3.2.heading: Annex 9 Control of conformity of production > Tests > Alignment of dipped-beam headlamps and front fog lamps towards the front
R48|base|Annex 9 1.3.2.text:
Variation of inclination with load The variation of the dipped-beam downward inclination as a function of the loading conditions specified within this section shall remain within the range:
|Mounting height h [m]|Upper inclination limit|Lower inclination limit|
|---|---|---|
||[per cent]|[per cent]|
|0.5 ≤ h ≤ 0.9|-0.50|- (h + 1.2)|
|0.9 < h ≤ 1.2|- (h x 2.17 - 1.45)|- (h x 2.17 + 0.15)|
|1.2 < h ≤ 1.5|||
In the case of a front fog lamp with (a) light source(s) having a total objective luminous flux which exceeds 2,000 lumens, the variation of the downward inclination as a function of the loading conditions specified within this section shall remain within the range: h < 0.8: 0.7 per cent minimum vertical inclination and 3.3 per cent maximum vertical inclination; h > 0,8: 1.2 per cent minimum vertical inclination and 3.8 per cent maximum vertical inclination. The states of loading to be used shall be as follows, as indicated in Annex 5 of this Regulation, for every system adjusted accordingly.

R48|base|Annex 9 1.3.2.1.heading: Annex 9 Control of conformity of production > Tests > Alignment of dipped-beam headlamps and front fog lamps towards the front
R48|base|Annex 9 1.3.2.1.text: Vehicles in category M1: Paragraph 2.1.1.1. Paragraph 2.1.1.6. taking into account Paragraph 2.1.2.

R48|base|Annex 9 1.3.2.2.heading: Annex 9 Control of conformity of production > Tests > Alignment of dipped-beam headlamps and front fog lamps towards the front
R48|base|Annex 9 1.3.2.2.text: Vehicles in category M2 and M3: Paragraph 2.2.1. Paragraph 2.2.2.

R48|base|Annex 9 1.3.2.3.heading: Annex 9 Control of conformity of production > Tests > Alignment of dipped-beam headlamps and front fog lamps towards the front
R48|base|Annex 9 1.3.2.3.text: Vehicles in category N with load surfaces: Paragraph 2.3.1.1. Paragraph 2.3.1.2.

R48|base|Annex 9 1.3.2.4.1.heading: Annex 9 Control of conformity of production > Tests > Alignment of dipped-beam headlamps and front fog lamps towards the front
R48|base|Annex 9 1.3.2.4.1.text: Drawing vehicles for semi-trailers: Paragraph 2.4.1.1. Paragraph 2.4.1.2.

R48|base|Annex 9 1.3.2.4.heading: Annex 9 Control of conformity of production > Tests > Alignment of dipped-beam headlamps and front fog lamps towards the front
R48|base|Annex 9 1.3.2.4.text: Vehicles in category N without load surfaces:

R48|base|Annex 9 1.3.2.4.2.heading: Annex 9 Control of conformity of production > Tests > Alignment of dipped-beam headlamps and front fog lamps towards the front
R48|base|Annex 9 1.3.2.4.2.text: Drawing vehicles for trailers: Paragraph 2.4.2.1. Paragraph 2.4.2.2.

R48|base|Annex 9 1.4.heading: Annex 9 Control of conformity of production > Tests
R48|base|Annex 9 1.4.text: Electrical connections and tell-tales The electrical connections shall be checked by switching on every lamp supplied by the electrical system of the vehicle. The lamps and tell-tales shall function in accordance with the provisions set out in paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. of this Regulation and with the individual specifications applicable to each lamp.

R48|base|Annex 9 1.5.1.heading: Annex 9 Control of conformity of production > Tests > Light intensities
R48|base|Annex 9 1.5.1.text: Main-beam headlamps The aggregate maximum intensity of the main beam headlamps shall be checked by the procedure described in paragraph 6.1.9.2. of this Regulation. The value obtained shall be such that the requirement in paragraph 6.1.9.1. of this Regulation is fulfilled.

R48|base|Annex 9 1.5.title: Light intensities
R48|base|Annex 9 1.5.heading: Annex 9 Control of conformity of production > Tests

R48|base|Annex 9 1.6.heading: Annex 9 Control of conformity of production > Tests
R48|base|Annex 9 1.6.text: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of lamps shall be checked by visual inspection of the lamps and their markings. These shall be such that the requirements set out in paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. as well as in the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
